data.protocol: per-user leave-last-two; all train prefix targets exactly once per epoch; test context includes observed validation target
data.candidate_universe: all 12101 static catalogue items; no sampled negatives; no seen-item masking

evaluation.collision_resolution: preserve byte-pinned complete SID paths including original suffix ownership
evaluation.invalid_beams: retain as miss at original rank
evaluation.screening_metric: Primary: validation item NDCG@10 at epoch60; also report fixed epochs10/20/30/40/50 and best-validation checkpoint separately.

reference.random_control: derange exactly the priority-changed item set;preserve their available original paths;not matched for semantic distortion/transposition count
reference.comparability: Uniform/priority differ in proposal mechanism;both use ALS. Legacycooc20ktrials differ in edit budgets,so they are contextual references,not pure CF-signal ablations.
reference.budget_endpoint: Rank candidates at epoch10,even if best validation occurred at epoch5. Save best/last,optimizer/scaler/TorchCPU/CUDA/Python/NumPy RNG and exact indices for later continuation.

research_question.hypothesis: The fixed ALS-swapped index may require longer generator training before quality separates from the original index.
research_question.candidate_selection: ALS uniform selected by epoch10 NDCG@10 among the current three RQ-KMeans screen variants; exploratory validation-based selection, not a new independent test.
research_question.scope: Exactly two fresh 60-epoch fits; no graph refit, extra candidate, seed, automatic retry or test evaluation.
research_question.comparison: Identical initialization/data/order/optimizer, one original and one frozen ALS uniform SID lookup, one worker each.
research_question.interpretation: Late widening, convergence or reversal must be assessed on the full validation trajectory; a final non-plateau remains inconclusive about asymptotic performance.
